Chant: "Say it with me" now says a spoken turn cue and shows a visual mark, then leaves a timed gap. It never listens (no microphone). A real chant or call-and-response scene would need a new scene or block type in lib/types.ts, which I don't own.
The balance only models x on the left (xCount, leftUnits, rightUnits in lib/types.ts). Equations with x on both sides would need a type change.
Some voices (for example Chrome's network voices) send no word-boundary events. In that case the whole piece being read is underlined instead of single words.
The lesson teaching act is logged only for lessons that have something to check. Its intent, lesson-checks-pass, can't resolve otherwise.
